llm.summary: This is a narrow markdown-only code-review skill for finding over-engineering in diffs, with no code execution, persistence, or hidden data access.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires only reading user-provided diffs and producing review comments, which is proportionate to its purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only a SKILL.md file with metadata and instructions; no bundled scripts, dependencies, or remote payloads were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill deliberately excludes correctness, security, and performance review; that is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should not treat it as a comprehensive review.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential handling, privilege escalation, background execution, or local system modification is requested or described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and instructions align: it formats concise findings about unnecessary complexity and explicitly says it does not apply fixes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: This appears safe to install for a very specific review style: short comments about code that can be deleted or simplified. Use a normal review pass as well when you need bugs, security, performance, or maintainability assessed beyond over-engineering.
